candidates.title: TWAP 'OLD' fallback shortens the oracle window, enabling price manipulation of margin/liquidation
candidates.description: UniHelper.callUniswapObserve requests a 30-min TWAP; on the Uniswap 'OLD' revert it falls back to ago = block.timestamp - oldestAvailableAge, i.e. a window potentially far shorter than 30 min. PositionCalculator.getSqrtIndexPrice uses this TWAP for isLiquidatable/min-margin, so on a pool with short observation history the effective TWAP is cheaper to manipulate.

candidates.title: TWAP 'OLD' fallback shortens the oracle window -> manipulable margin/liquidation price
candidates.description: UniHelper.callUniswapObserve falls back from the 30-min TWAP to ago=block.timestamp-oldestAvailableAge on the 'OLD' revert; a low-cardinality pool yields a short, manipulable TWAP used by PositionCalculator.getSqrtIndexPrice for margin/liquidation.

candidates.title: Bad-debt vault can be unliquidatable: liquidator must cover the shortfall via transferFrom
candidates.description: In liquidate(), when the position is fully closed and remainingMargin<0, the contract does ERC20.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), -remainingMargin) to make the liquidator cover the loss. A liquidator lacking the quote token or approval reverts, so a deeply-underwater vault may have no party willing/able to liquidate it.

candidates.title: Bad-debt vault can be unliquidatable: liquidator must fund the shortfall
candidates.description: liquidate(): remainingMargin<0 requires ERC20.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, -remainingMargin); a liquidator without quote token/approval reverts, so a deeply-underwater vault may have no party able to liquidate it.

candidates.title: Dutch-auction liquidation slippage grows as vault value drops -> liquidator over-extraction
candidates.description: calculateSlippageTolerance returns toward maxSlippage as vaultValue->0, so low-value vaults can be liquidated at a price up to maxSlippage from oracle, enabling liquidator/MEV extraction.

candidates.title: Residual margin stranded when a vault is closed by liquidation with recipient unset
candidates.description: When !hasPosition && remainingMargin>0 but vault.recipient == address(0), the transfer block is skipped and vault.margin is neither zeroed nor swept — the positive residual margin is stranded.

candidates.title: Residual margin stranded on liquidation-close when vault.recipient is unset
candidates.description: liquidate(): when !hasPosition && remainingMargin>0 but vault.recipient==address(0), the transfer block is skipped and vault.margin is not zeroed/swept -> residual stranded.

candidates.title: Direct-fill settlement uses a filler-supplied price (bounded only by post-trade slippage)
candidates.description: SettlementCallbackLib sell/buy direct-fill path (contractAddress==0) computes quoteAmount from settlementParams.price, a filler-supplied value; only SlippageLib.checkPrice against the oracle bounds the abuse, so a filler can self-deal within the slippage band.

candidates.title: Direct-fill settlement uses a filler-supplied price (bounded only by slippage)
candidates.description: SettlementCallbackLib direct-fill (contractAddress==0) prices via settlementParams.price (filler-supplied); only the post-trade SlippageLib.checkPrice bounds it -> filler self-dealing within the slippage band.
